entries.reason: Go-only enhancement (documented in tui/conversations.go handleInput): an EMPTY conversation list routes Up to the tab bar (checkbox -> tab bar) so the tab bar stays keyboard-reachable; Python routes Up on an empty list straight to the menubar (Conversations.py:1800-1802 body_is_empty). With the seeded state the Trusted list was empty, so the start path landed on different widgets.

DELIBERATE owner decision (fleet bug #7, 2026-09-01): urwid's RadioButton group init leaves BOTH Untrusted and Unknown checked (True/True/False verified against the installed urwid); the owner asked for exactly one pre-checked radio (Unknown). Python's confirmed() checks r_unknown first, so a no-toggle Create stores the same trust in both.

Python 1.2.8 CRASHES on Ctrl-X with an empty conversations list: get_selected_item returns the empty-placeholder AttrMap (not None), the source_hash attribute is missing, and the unhandled AttributeError tears down the whole app (logfile: 'AttrMap object has no attribute source_hash'). The Go port deliberately survives: Ctrl-X is a no-op. Do not replicate the crash.
Python 1.2.8 CRASHES on Ctrl-Y at the seeded boot state (RuntimeError: stdin has been closed, urwid main-loop input EOF). The Go port survives. Do not replicate the crash.
